title: What should buyers compare when sourcing custom paper tube packaging? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What should buyers compare when sourcing custom paper tube packaging?
buyer_context: cosmetics, candles, tea, fragrance, specialty retail and premium small-product packaging
short_answer: Buyers should compare suppliers by the clarity of their product route, RFQ inputs, material and finish discussion, and how well the packaging structure fits the product use case. For paper tube packaging, start with diameter and height, cap or closure style, inner fit, product weight, print and finish direction.
